name: Chicky Jumper
author: Addicting Games
description: Chicky Jumper is a free clicker game. You are the cutest cube-based chick that ever did cluck and all you want to do is fly your way home. The problem is that your path is beset by obstacles of all kinds, flaming roosters, spinning spikes, emerald lasers, and the dreaded floating platforms of doom. All you can do is click, wait, and click again but all at the right time. Clicking is how you fly and every click will take you up and let you drop in predictable increments. Your mission is going to be to use those clicks to fly and avoid the worst obstacles possible in order to make it to the top of the leader board. Rise up ever higher in this endless runner style clicking game where every click brings you closer to the sweet, sweet taste of victory.  You want to grow up to be a strong confident chicken but you're going to face a lot of obstacles. Not all of them will be as literal or as deadly as the fire-breathing roosters and emerald lasers that block your path but all of them will challenge and change you. Raise your beak, straighten your back and learn to overcome before you become overwhelmed in this fast, fun, and free clicker game.
